background: Longtime NBA assistant (born 1975) known as a player-development specialist. Started as a Spurs video coordinator, then spent most of 2007-15 on Scott Brooks' Oklahoma City staff working closely with Kevin Durant, Russell Westbrook and Serge Ibaka; later assistant stops with the Knicks, Nets (Kenny Atkinson), Lakers and Wizards (under Wes Unseld Jr.). Named Washington's interim head coach in Jan 2024 at 7-36 (went 8-31), then permanent head coach in May 2024 by GM Will Dawkins as the face of a full rebuild. His record through 2025-26 is 43-160 (.214, second-worst in NBA history for 150+ games): 18-64 in 2024-25 and a league-worst 17-65 in 2025-26, both intentionally development-focused seasons around Alex Sarr, Bub Carrington, Kyshawn George, Bilal Coulibaly and Tre Johnson. Dawkins retained him for 2026-27 citing individual player improvement; with an upgraded veteran roster the Wizards opened 3-3 (through Nov 1, 2026). Style: defense built on rim protection, early-offense pace and ball movement, deep experimental rotations; critics call the offense structureless and the late-game management poor.
